facts.why: Wikipedia's Critters 2 plot and Moria's review spell the town 'Grover's Bend' with an apostrophe. The Critters page itself does not name the town, and I could not confirm the on-screen spelling.

notes: Breakfast and waiting on Charlie, the half-eaten cow, the firecracker, the church and bowling alley panic, the whiskey bottle Molotov, Johnny Steele, the fillings and the eggs in the chicken's nest all in Wikipedia plot. Brad's spy probe line on Wikiquote. Three dishes print with no food line (burnt ends, pancakes, whiskey sour) and the right column has a big empty gap above the quote.

vibe.verdict: The farm kitchen placemat is the right place, but half the notes are bare plot lines with no food, the right column sits half empty and the Krites themselves barely show.
